candidate_identity.name: C34 dual-horizon inverse-volatility five-ETF paper candidate

actual_instruments.name: 华宝现金添益ETF（A类）
actual_instruments.dynamic_target: 100 percent only in warm-up or when no risk sleeve is active

dynamic_rule.observation: after the final common market-price close in each calendar month
dynamic_rule.score: for every sleeve, equal mean of 126- and 252-common-observation market-price returns; equity is the equal mean of the two component returns at each horizon
dynamic_rule.eligibility: risk sleeve score strictly greater than fallback score; equality is inactive
dynamic_rule.weighting: active risk sleeves proportional to inverse trailing-60-common-one-session-return sample volatility (ddof=1)
dynamic_rule.invalid_input: NO_ACTION; invalid input does not create an automatic fallback target

timing_and_actions.earliest_effective_session: E: following common session at reported open; D must precede E
timing_and_actions.historical_proxy_cost: 20 bp times one-way turnover, illustrative only

all_required: current legal document and temporary-announcement review
timestamped bid, ask and visible two-sided depth
product-, venue-, account- and date-specific lot, tick and settlement facts
valid rule inputs and prior reconciliation
pre_action_controls.fail_closed: Any missing or failed condition, partial fill, no fill, rejection, suspension, price-limit lock, or unreconciled record is NO_ACTION; no code substitution or synthetic fill.

historical_proxy_evidence.basis: retrospective SSE market-price observations with undisclosed adjustment basis; not total return, NAV return, executable quote, fill or investor result
historical_proxy_evidence.formula_integrity: pre_formal_recompute_not_true_preregistration; formula was formalized after prior exploratory observation

risk_and_invalidation.concentration: A target can concentrate in one bond or gold sleeve; inverse volatility is not a correlation, capacity or diversification proof.
risk_and_invalidation.operational_pause: Source/hash discrepancy, invalid rule input, product or legal-status change, access or settlement failure, missing/invalid quote or IOPV, partial/no-fill event, unreconciled ledger, or rule change.

futures.reason: C16/C17 strict diagnostics failed and do not supply implementation evidence.

open_universe_boundary.this_rule_only: All products outside the exact five-code set have zero weight in this rule version; this is not a permanent universe exclusion.

entry_requirements.direct_stocks: full equity-research, valuation, risk, governance, industry-chain, tradability and independent-review package per stock
entry_requirements.funds_reits_bonds: point-in-time universe, total-return/event, fee, status and execution evidence
entry_requirements.derivatives: contract, margin, limit, roll or exercise, fee, settlement, quote, no-fill and forward-paper evidence

upstream_venue_master_manifest.scope: Six R4 master-response codes: five actual-core codes 510300, 510880, 511010, 518880 and 511990, plus non-core 510500.

evidence_refs.use: independent source integrity and remaining actionability blockers
